title: Payroll bank-file upload: SFTP sessions left open when an upload breaks
name: Payroll SFTP uploader

questions.prompt: During a network blip at the bank, two employers' payroll uploads failed with 'close failed: connection is gone'. Every upload after that failed with 'too many sessions for user', so most employers weren't paid until someone restarted the payroll worker. The bank's support team says our account had sessions open for hours. Fix payroll/uploader.ts so the tests pass.
